title: Sagan's NSA contractor green badge

tellings.quote: he had a contractor green badge with a picture on it you you don't get that if you're casual

plain: The astronomer Carl Sagan is said to have carried a green contractor badge with his photo on it from the National Security Agency, the NSA. Bob Maguire, a former CIA contractor, tells Michels he saw it, and says "you don't get that if you're casual." If so, Sagan had a real working tie to the agency, not just a passing one.
